        (1, 0): 24.34292430654904, (1, 1): 18.69161579278047, (1, 2): 16.96075239636408,
        (2, 0): 15.44135005337596, (2, 1): 24.75403844533352, (2, 2): 17.09921582696376,
    },
    "startup_time": {0: 6.900949355420833, 1: 7.255877688483005},
    "capacity": {0: 73.62985121550206, 1: 69.3191618930891},
    "machines": [0, 1],
    "products": [0, 1, 2],
    "periods": [0, 1, 2],
    "bigM": {0: 73.62985121550206, 1: 69.3191618930891},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.M = pyo.Set(initialize=d["machines"], ordered=True)
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"], ordered=True)
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["periods"], ordered=True)

    # x: production quantity
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.M, m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # y: production setup indicator (produce product p on machine m in period t)
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.M, m.P, m.T, within=pyo.Binary)
    # z: machine startup indicator
    m.z = pyo.Var(m.M, m.P, m.T, within=pyo.Binary)
    # I: end-of-period inventory
    m.I = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # B: end-of-period backlog
    m.B = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ---- Objective: minimize total operational cost ----
    def obj_rule(mm):
        setup = sum(d["setup_cost"] * mm.y[i, p, t]
                    for i in mm.M for p in mm.P for t in mm.T)
        startup = sum(d["startup_cost"] * mm.z[i, p, t]
                      for i in mm.M for p in mm.P for t in mm.T)
        holding = sum(d["holding_cost"][p] * mm.I[p, t]
                      for p in mm.P for t in mm.T)
        backlog = sum(d["backlog_cost"][p] * mm.B[p, t]
                      for p in mm.P for t in mm.T)
        return setup + startup + holding + backlog

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---- Demand balance: sum_m x[m,p,t] + I[p,t-1] - B[p,t-1] == demand + I[p,t] - B[p,t]
    # Rearranged (<=) form avoided; we write equality via two-sided rule.
    def demand_bal_rule(mm, p, t):
        lhs = sum(mm.x[i, p, t] for i in mm.M)
        prev_I = mm.I[p, t - 1] if t - 1 in mm.T else 0
        prev_B = mm.B[p, t - 1] if t - 1 in mm.T else 0
        return lhs + prev_I - prev_B == d["demand"][(p, t)] + mm.I[p, t] - mm.B[p, t]

    m.demand_bal = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=demand_bal_rule)

    # ---- Machine capacity: sum_p x + startup_time * sum_p z <= capacity ----
    def cap_rule(mm, i, t):
        load = sum(mm.x[i, p, t] for p in mm.P)
        st = d["startup_time"][i] * sum(mm.z[i, p, t] for p in mm.P)
        return load + st <= d["capacity"][i]

    m.cap = pyo.Constraint(m.M, m.T, rule=cap_rule)

    # ---- One product per machine per period: sum_p y[i,p,t] <= 1 ----
    def one_prod_rule(mm, i, t):
        return sum(mm.y[i, p, t] for p in mm.P) <= 1

    m.one_prod = pyo.Constraint(m.M, m.T, rule=one_prod_rule)

    # ---- Linking: x[i,p,t] <= bigM * y[i,p,t] ----
    def link_rule(mm, i, p, t):
        return mm.x[i, p, t] <= d["bigM"][i] * mm.y[i, p, t]

    m.link = pyo.Constraint(m.M, m.P, m.T, rule=link_rule)

    # ---- Startup logic: z[i,p,t] >= y[i,p,t] - y[i,p,t-1]  (y[i,p,-1]=0) ----
    def startup_rule(mm, i, p, t):
        prev = mm.y[i, p, t - 1] if t - 1 in mm.T else 0
        return mm.z[i, p, t] >= mm.y[i, p, t] - prev

    m.startup = pyo.Constraint(m.M, m.P, m.T, rule=startup_rule)

    return m

    "capacity": {0: 73.62985121550206, 1: 69.3191618930891},

    # big-M for production linking
    "bigM": 1.0e5,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.MACHINES = pyo.Set(initialize=d["machines"])
    m.PRODUCTS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    m.PERIODS = pyo.Set(initialize=d["periods"])

    # ---- Variables ----
    m.produce = pyo.Var(m.MACHINES, m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS,
                        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.use = pyo.Var(m.MACHINES, m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS, within=pyo.Binary)
    m.startup = pyo.Var(m.MACHINES, m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS, within=pyo.Binary)
    m.inventory = pyo.Var(m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.backlog = pyo.Var(m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ---- Objective ----
    def obj_rule(mm):
        setup = sum(d["setup_cost"] * mm.use[i, j, t]
                    for i in mm.MACHINES for j in mm.PRODUCTS for t in mm.PERIODS)
        startup = sum(d["startup_cost"] * mm.startup[i, j, t]
                      for i in mm.MACHINES for j in mm.PRODUCTS for t in mm.PERIODS)
        holding = sum(d["hold_cost"][j] * mm.inventory[j, t]
                      for j in mm.PRODUCTS for t in mm.PERIODS)
        penalty = sum(d["backlog_cost"][j] * mm.backlog[j, t]
                      for j in mm.PRODUCTS for t in mm.PERIODS)
        return setup + startup + holding + penalty

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---- Demand balance ----
    def demand_balance_rule(mm, j, t):
        prod = sum(mm.produce[i, j, t] for i in mm.MACHINES)
        prev_inv = mm.inventory[j, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0
        prev_bl = mm.backlog[j, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0
        return (prod + prev_inv - prev_bl
                == d["demand"][j][t] + mm.inventory[j, t] - mm.backlog[j, t])

    m.demand_balance = pyo.Constraint(m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS,
                                      rule=demand_balance_rule)

    # ---- Machine capacity (production + startup time) ----
    def capacity_rule(mm, i, t):
        prod = sum(mm.produce[i, j, t] for j in mm.PRODUCTS)
        st = d["startup_time"][i] * sum(mm.startup[i, j, t] for j in mm.PRODUCTS)
        return prod + st <= d["capacity"][i]

    m.capacity = pyo.Constraint(m.MACHINES, m.PERIODS, rule=capacity_rule)

    # ---- One product per machine per period ----
    def one_product_rule(mm, i, t):
        return sum(mm.use[i, j, t] for j in mm.PRODUCTS) <= 1

    m.one_product = pyo.Constraint(m.MACHINES, m.PERIODS, rule=one_product_rule)

    # ---- Production linked to usage ----
    def link_rule(mm, i, j, t):
        return mm.produce[i, j, t] <= d["bigM"] * mm.use[i, j, t]

    m.production_link = pyo.Constraint(m.MACHINES, m.PRODUCTS, m.PERIODS,
                                       rule=link_rule)

    # ---- Startup logic ----
    def startup_first_rule(mm, i, j):
        return mm.startup[i, j, 0] >= mm.use[i, j, 0]

    m.startup_first = pyo.Constraint(m.MACHINES, m.PRODUCTS,
                                     rule=startup_first_rule)

    def startup_later_rule(mm, i, j, t):
        return mm.startup[i, j, t] >= mm.use[i, j, t] - mm.use[i, j, t - 1]

    m.startup_later = pyo.Constraint(
        m.MACHINES, m.PRODUCTS,
        [t for t in d["periods"] if t > 0],
        rule=startup_later_rule)

    return m
